experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4032:./reviews/deep_22.md:11273:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 里常见做法是水平切分身体做局部对齐，但行人姿态、视角和运动不规则，水平条带经常语义错位。生成式跨模态图像又容易引入噪声，所以作者转向特征层。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4034:./reviews/deep_22.md:11277:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFGM 用多分支膨胀卷积、注意力和中心引导 pair mining 生成多样但靠近共享分布的特征；PLM 用可学习原型给像素级特征加权，挖出跨 VIS/IR 语义相似的局部；Lch 保证原型多样，Ldcs 让类内靠近、类间中心分离。机制和重定义有联系，但比 PDA 弱一些，更像把“潜在局部”问题工程化。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4035:./reviews/deep_22.md:11309:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 的可见光和红外图像有大模态差异，视觉特征很难直接对齐。已有 CLIP prompt 方法说明语义空间有帮助，但可学习 prompt 语义不透明、太粗、还要两阶段训练。LLaVA 能生成显式细粒度描述，但跨模态描述会有冲突，比如同一衣服在可见光里是蓝色，在红外里像灰色；同一身份不同视角的描述又互补。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4037:./reviews/deep_22.md:11313:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ESFA 用 LLaVA 给可见光和红外图像生成描述，在各自模态内做图文对齐。CSIA 不直接强拉图像和异模态文本，而是约束“模态内图文相似度”和“跨模态文本相似度”一致，绕开颜色冲突。CVSC 用同身份其他视角文本补偿当前文本，把一对一图文匹配扩成一对多语义对齐。机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4047:./reviews/deep_22.md:11350:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 里常见做法是水平切分身体做局部对齐，但行人姿态、视角和运动不规则，水平条带经常语义错位。生成式跨模态图像又容易引入噪声，所以作者转向特征层。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4049:./reviews/deep_22.md:11354:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFGM 用多分支膨胀卷积、注意力和中心引导 pair mining 生成多样但靠近共享分布的特征；PLM 用可学习原型给像素级特征加权，挖出跨 VIS/IR 语义相似的局部；Lch 保证原型多样，Ldcs 让类内靠近、类间中心分离。机制和重定义有联系，但比 PDA 弱一些，更像把“潜在局部”问题工程化。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4050:./reviews/deep_22.md:11386:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 的可见光和红外图像有大模态差异，视觉特征很难直接对齐。已有 CLIP prompt 方法说明语义空间有帮助，但可学习 prompt 语义不透明、太粗、还要两阶段训练。LLaVA 能生成显式细粒度描述，但跨模态描述会有冲突，比如同一衣服在可见光里是蓝色，在红外里像灰色；同一身份不同视角的描述又互补。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4052:./reviews/deep_22.md:11390:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ESFA 用 LLaVA 给可见光和红外图像生成描述，在各自模态内做图文对齐。CSIA 不直接强拉图像和异模态文本，而是约束“模态内图文相似度”和“跨模态文本相似度”一致，绕开颜色冲突。CVSC 用同身份其他视角文本补偿当前文本，把一对一图文匹配扩成一对多语义对齐。机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4058:./analyses/deep_15.txt:6:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制基本是顺着重定义推出来的。短程和长程特征先由 SLE 得到，再用白化超图 HSL 建高阶关系，白化是为了解决高阶关系塌成单一连接的问题。随后 FCGA 同时做细粒度节点对齐和粗粒度区域对齐，生成中间特征。HMAL 把中间特征变成每个 stage 的代理，并做低层和高层的双向增强。MRIC 再用身份中心把 VIS、IR 和 middle features 拉到更稳的共同空间。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4059:./analyses/deep_15.txt:26:2. **重定义动作**：作者把问题从“做数据增强”改成“生成能训练 ReID 的身份一致跨模态数据”。关键词是 `controllable diffusion`、`infrared modality understanding`、`text adapter alignment`、`identity-aware generation`、`Generated Cross-modal Person Dataset`。大家以为生成更多图片就行，其实 ReID 合成数据必须同时满足红外风格、文本语义、身份一致和跨模态配对。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4060:./analyses/deep_15.txt:28:4. **证据闭环**：他们用生成可视化证明同一文本下身份更一致，比如眼镜等细节能保留。ControlNet 条件比较证明 SoftEdge 比 depth 更适合红外，因为它保留边缘和身份细节。LoRA 和 text adapter 的消融用 CLIP Score 和 FID 证明语义理解更好。GCP 加到 CCLNet、OTPA、RPNR、SDCL 等基线后都有提升，t-SNE 显示同一身份跨模态距离更近。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4062:./analyses/deep_15.txt:41:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MakeHuman 生成不同体型、肤色、发型的人体模型，再加骨架和行走动画。衣服模型本身没有足够纹理，于是用 normal maps 条件训练 ControlNet，引导 Stable Diffusion 生成和衣服表面结构对齐的 UV texture maps，再导入 UE4 材质系统。采集上设计 sub-monitoring network，每个子网络用少量摄像头覆盖局部区域，并让人物沿循环路径移动，控制视角、背景、光照和遮挡。UnrealCV 自动得到实例分割和裁剪。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4072:./reviews/deep_26.md:496:- B 生成/合成数据: CCUP/InfinitePerson/Identity Diffuser/扩散增广,找适中成本+新颖的生成机制(换衣战场PRCC 49 vs SOTA 55-66,CCUP用百万合成预训练)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4268:./reviews/deep_26.md:13033:3. 机制怎么长出来：先用少量标注训练分类器，给无标注样本生成带置信度的软身份标签；再用 self-mimic 把同一身份在同一模态内拉向模态特定原型；最后用 mutual distillation 做可见和红外的双向分布对齐。先同模态收紧，再跨模态对齐，机制和重定义绑定很紧。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4674:./analyses/deep_3.txt:8:4. 证据闭环：关键不是只报 SOTA，而是分别验证 training sample expansion 和 cross-modal generation 对多个基线都有效，并做生成图、潜空间插值、非线性层消融、统计检验。它在证明“同一个潜空间确实能同时支撑两种生成任务”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4676:./analyses/deep_3.txt:37:1. 触发观察：VI-ReID 过去常把跨模态差异当作要消除的东西，结果共享对齐会丢掉可见光颜色纹理、红外热特征这些细节；生成式补偿又会引入噪声或依赖辅助模型。BDLF 论文页面也明确把缺口说成“只挖 shared，忽略 modality-specific details”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.03286))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4677:./analyses/deep_3.txt:41:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是视角和形式化机制。它不是说“我又对齐了一下”，而是说“过度对齐会损失有用细节”。近邻工作里 SGIEL 已经用正交子空间和形状擦除来挖 shared cue，LUPI 也用中间域补信息，所以 BDLF 的边界在“base/detail 相关性分解，而非额外生成或形状特权信息”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.04205?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.09348?utm_source=openai))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4681:./analyses/deep_3.txt:53:这批论文共同不是从“我加了一个模块”开始，而是先把已有失败讲成一个更精确的新问题：过度对齐丢细节、整体 CLIP 忽略属性、3D 只用几何没用纹理、生成图像缺身份一致性。然后机制基本从这个新定义里长出来，最后用一个能直接验证新定义的消融或可视化闭环兜住，而不是只报涨点。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4695:./analyses/deep_1.txt:21:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制基本是自然推出的。既然 2D 帧被遮挡和错位破坏，就用 SMPL/HMR 生成 3D mesh，转成 point cloud，再用 PointPillars 得到和 2D feature 对齐的 pseudo-image feature；CMF 用 deformable cross-attention 和 2D-3D 映射点做融合；SSTI 用 SMPL shape 参数建 spatial/temporal 两条注意力流，专门处理相似外观混淆。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4696:./analyses/deep_1.txt:29:1. **触发观察**：作者观察到 visible 和 infrared 的频谱分布不同，IR 更集中在低频，visible 有更多中高频细节。现有方法要么做图像生成，要么做特征空间对齐；已有频域 VI-ReID 如 FDNM 已提出频域差异，但大多把频率当成一个统一处理工具。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02162?utm_source=openai))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4708:./analyses/deep_11.txt:65:1. 触发观察：VI-ReID 里很多方法都试图补齐或消除可见光和红外的信息差，比如生成、对齐、模态不变特征。作者反过来指出，完全桥接信息差很难，而且即使桥接，也不一定能稳定抓到身份判别线索。真正挑战是模型面对不同模态、不同实例、不同 query 时都要能灵活适配。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4713:./analyses/deep_10.txt:7:3. 机制怎么长出来：模态因子既然跨整个训练集存在，就用类别记忆队列加 memory-attention，再用 OT 让同身份跨模态记忆靠近。姿态因子既然来自人体结构，就用 parsing 和 landmark 生成 skeleton，再用正交分解把 skeleton 里的姿态信息和身份信息拆开。机制和重定义绑定较紧，但模块偏重。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4717:./analyses/deep_10.txt:39:3. 机制怎么长出来：全局表征负责整个人，属性表征负责细粒度局部属性。ATG 先用属性识别器生成属性文本，TGA 用 CLIP 融合图文得到全局表征，ACN 得到属性级表征；AF 用属性表征对齐旧新模型，KC 用全局表征做知识转移。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:4725:./analyses/deep_26.txt:45:3. 机制怎么长出来：先用少量标注训练分类器，给无标注样本生成带置信度的软身份标签；再用 self-mimic 把同一身份在同一模态内拉向模态特定原型；最后用 mutual distillation 做可见和红外的双向分布对齐。先同模态收紧，再跨模态对齐，机制和重定义绑定很紧。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5100:./reviews/deep_25.md:14051:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然 IR 少，直接复制图像会过拟合，SMOTE 又会偏离分布，那么就不在图像空间生成，而是在深层特征里扰动 IR 的 style statistics。SSP 用 IR 特征的均值和方差估计 style 范围，随机采样新的缩放和平移，生成语义不变但风格变化的 IR-like 特征。随后用 MMD 对齐 RGB、真实 IR、扰动 IR 三个分布，再用 CACS 做类中心层面的 intra-class 和 inter-class 约束。机制和重定义绑定很紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5101:./reviews/deep_25.md:14053:4. **证据闭环**：最关键证据是人为构造不同失衡比例。SYSU-MM01 从 2:1 到 4:1、8:1，很多已有方法 rank-1 和 mAP 大幅下滑，而 CMBL 下滑明显小。组件消融也很有说服力：2:1 下 baseline 是 63.79 rank-1、59.87 mAP，完整 CMBL 到 76.36、71.64；8:1 下 baseline 是 40.20、34.39，完整 CMBL 到 70.62、65.72。SSP 插入层位置、MMD 三项、CACS 的 intra/inter 都分别消融。可视化上还对比 SMOTE 和 SSP 的生成分布，并展示分类 logit 更稳定。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5108:./reviews/deep_25.md:14075:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5112:./reviews/deep_25.md:14130:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然 IR 少，直接复制图像会过拟合，SMOTE 又会偏离分布，那么就不在图像空间生成，而是在深层特征里扰动 IR 的 style statistics。SSP 用 IR 特征的均值和方差估计 style 范围，随机采样新的缩放和平移，生成语义不变但风格变化的 IR-like 特征。随后用 MMD 对齐 RGB、真实 IR、扰动 IR 三个分布，再用 CACS 做类中心层面的 intra-class 和 inter-class 约束。机制和重定义绑定很紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5113:./reviews/deep_25.md:14132:4. **证据闭环**：最关键证据是人为构造不同失衡比例。SYSU-MM01 从 2:1 到 4:1、8:1，很多已有方法 rank-1 和 mAP 大幅下滑，而 CMBL 下滑明显小。组件消融也很有说服力：2:1 下 baseline 是 63.79 rank-1、59.87 mAP，完整 CMBL 到 76.36、71.64；8:1 下 baseline 是 40.20、34.39，完整 CMBL 到 70.62、65.72。SSP 插入层位置、MMD 三项、CACS 的 intra/inter 都分别消融。可视化上还对比 SMOTE 和 SSP 的生成分布，并展示分类 logit 更稳定。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5120:./reviews/deep_25.md:14154:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5124:./analyses/deep_19.txt:45:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制很顺。先用 SCHP 生成衣服擦除图，再用 AAPAR 识别 35 类属性。年龄、性别被当作身份相关属性，头饰、上衣、下装、鞋、配饰等被当作衣服相关属性。然后用模板把属性变成文本，在 raw image branch 和 masked image branch 上用 CLIP ViT 加 visual deep prompt 学图像表示。属性解耦部分把图像特征和身份相关文本拼接，用 triplet 促进保留；对衣服相关文本用负向损失或对抗约束进行压制。BNNeck 用来隔开图像调优和文本对齐，避免一个目标破坏另一个目标。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5135:./analyses/deep_22.txt:17:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 里常见做法是水平切分身体做局部对齐，但行人姿态、视角和运动不规则，水平条带经常语义错位。生成式跨模态图像又容易引入噪声，所以作者转向特征层。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5137:./analyses/deep_22.txt:21:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFGM 用多分支膨胀卷积、注意力和中心引导 pair mining 生成多样但靠近共享分布的特征；PLM 用可学习原型给像素级特征加权，挖出跨 VIS/IR 语义相似的局部；Lch 保证原型多样，Ldcs 让类内靠近、类间中心分离。机制和重定义有联系，但比 PDA 弱一些，更像把“潜在局部”问题工程化。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5138:./analyses/deep_22.txt:53:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 的可见光和红外图像有大模态差异，视觉特征很难直接对齐。已有 CLIP prompt 方法说明语义空间有帮助，但可学习 prompt 语义不透明、太粗、还要两阶段训练。LLaVA 能生成显式细粒度描述，但跨模态描述会有冲突，比如同一衣服在可见光里是蓝色，在红外里像灰色；同一身份不同视角的描述又互补。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5140:./analyses/deep_22.txt:57:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ESFA 用 LLaVA 给可见光和红外图像生成描述，在各自模态内做图文对齐。CSIA 不直接强拉图像和异模态文本，而是约束“模态内图文相似度”和“跨模态文本相似度”一致，绕开颜色冲突。CVSC 用同身份其他视角文本补偿当前文本，把一对一图文匹配扩成一对多语义对齐。机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5157:./analyses/deep_4.txt:13:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇主要卖机制，视角有但不算特别深。reviewer 会买，是因为它把老的 VI-ReID 模态差异问题换成了一个容易接受的新动作：不要只对齐，要双向交换。真正 novelty 来自“直接用另一模态生成动态投影权重”，不是 GAP/GMP 或 weighted loss。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5603:./analyses/deep_21.txt:31:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5608:./analyses/deep_7.txt:49:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇卖的是完整视角：外部语义不可靠，视频内部可以自生成语义对齐。模块复杂，但每个模块都解释一个具体失败点，所以不像堆模块。novelty 主要来自“self-alignment without human topology”的问题重定义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5610:./analyses/deep_7.txt:57:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果 clean 是可靠 exemplar，corrupted 是异质模态，那么 teacher-student 蒸馏很自然：冻结 clean teacher，用 corrupted student 向 clean feature 对齐。严重 corruption 是 hard sample，所以加 weighted contrastive loss。又因为严格对齐会丢信息，所以用 Brownian bridge 生成 clean 与 corrupted 之间的中间特征，填出连续语义结构。机制和重定义绑定很强。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5626:./reviews/deep_5.md:807:- B 生成/合成数据: CCUP/InfinitePerson/Identity Diffuser/扩散增广,找适中成本+新颖的生成机制(换衣战场PRCC 49 vs SOTA 55-66,CCUP用百万合成预训练)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5784:./analyses/deep_6.txt:69:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 text 和 sketch 都缺属性，就生成一个同时含轮廓、颜色、纹理的 color sketch 作为桥。CSG 先做动态光照修正，再用 DoG 抽轮廓，并在 YUV 空间把轮廓放到亮度通道、颜色放到色度通道。ACRM 用 dissimilarity 找缺失信息并补偿，再用 photo-query dissimilarity 去掉辅助模态引入的噪声。UCA 再用身份保持、内容一致、三向结构约束和类内紧致损失统一对齐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5801:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:23:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制基本是自然推出的。既然 2D 帧被遮挡和错位破坏，就用 SMPL/HMR 生成 3D mesh，转成 point cloud，再用 PointPillars 得到和 2D feature 对齐的 pseudo-image feature；CMF 用 deformable cross-attention 和 2D-3D 映射点做融合；SSTI 用 SMPL shape 参数建 spatial/temporal 两条注意力流，专门处理相似外观混淆。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5802:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:31:1. **触发观察**：作者观察到 visible 和 infrared 的频谱分布不同，IR 更集中在低频，visible 有更多中高频细节。现有方法要么做图像生成，要么做特征空间对齐；已有频域 VI-ReID 如 FDNM 已提出频域差异，但大多把频率当成一个统一处理工具。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02162?utm_source=openai))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5809:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:90:3. 机制怎么长出来：模态因子既然跨整个训练集存在，就用类别记忆队列加 memory-attention，再用 OT 让同身份跨模态记忆靠近。姿态因子既然来自人体结构，就用 parsing 和 landmark 生成 skeleton，再用正交分解把 skeleton 里的姿态信息和身份信息拆开。机制和重定义绑定较紧，但模块偏重。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5813:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:122:3. 机制怎么长出来：全局表征负责整个人，属性表征负责细粒度局部属性。ATG 先用属性识别器生成属性文本，TGA 用 CLIP 融合图文得到全局表征，ACN 得到属性级表征；AF 用属性表征对齐旧新模型，KC 用全局表征做知识转移。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5823:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:205:1. 触发观察：VI-ReID 里很多方法都试图补齐或消除可见光和红外的信息差，比如生成、对齐、模态不变特征。作者反过来指出，完全桥接信息差很难，而且即使桥接，也不一定能稳定抓到身份判别线索。真正挑战是模型面对不同模态、不同实例、不同 query 时都要能灵活适配。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5847:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:391:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制基本是顺着重定义推出来的。短程和长程特征先由 SLE 得到，再用白化超图 HSL 建高阶关系，白化是为了解决高阶关系塌成单一连接的问题。随后 FCGA 同时做细粒度节点对齐和粗粒度区域对齐，生成中间特征。HMAL 把中间特征变成每个 stage 的代理，并做低层和高层的双向增强。MRIC 再用身份中心把 VIS、IR 和 middle features 拉到更稳的共同空间。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5848:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:411:2. **重定义动作**：作者把问题从“做数据增强”改成“生成能训练 ReID 的身份一致跨模态数据”。关键词是 `controllable diffusion`、`infrared modality understanding`、`text adapter alignment`、`identity-aware generation`、`Generated Cross-modal Person Dataset`。大家以为生成更多图片就行，其实 ReID 合成数据必须同时满足红外风格、文本语义、身份一致和跨模态配对。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5849:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:413:4. **证据闭环**：他们用生成可视化证明同一文本下身份更一致，比如眼镜等细节能保留。ControlNet 条件比较证明 SoftEdge 比 depth 更适合红外，因为它保留边缘和身份细节。LoRA 和 text adapter 的消融用 CLIP Score 和 FID 证明语义理解更好。GCP 加到 CCLNet、OTPA、RPNR、SDCL 等基线后都有提升，t-SNE 显示同一身份跨模态距离更近。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5851:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:426:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MakeHuman 生成不同体型、肤色、发型的人体模型，再加骨架和行走动画。衣服模型本身没有足够纹理，于是用 normal maps 条件训练 ControlNet，引导 Stable Diffusion 生成和衣服表面结构对齐的 UV texture maps，再导入 UE4 材质系统。采集上设计 sub-monitoring network，每个子网络用少量摄像头覆盖局部区域，并让人物沿循环路径移动，控制视角、背景、光照和遮挡。UnrealCV 自动得到实例分割和裁剪。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5857:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:662:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制很顺。先用 SCHP 生成衣服擦除图，再用 AAPAR 识别 35 类属性。年龄、性别被当作身份相关属性，头饰、上衣、下装、鞋、配饰等被当作衣服相关属性。然后用模板把属性变成文本，在 raw image branch 和 masked image branch 上用 CLIP ViT 加 visual deep prompt 学图像表示。属性解耦部分把图像特征和身份相关文本拼接，用 triplet 促进保留；对衣服相关文本用负向损失或对抗约束进行压制。BNNeck 用来隔开图像调优和文本对齐，避免一个目标破坏另一个目标。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5889:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:883:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5895:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:950:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 里常见做法是水平切分身体做局部对齐，但行人姿态、视角和运动不规则，水平条带经常语义错位。生成式跨模态图像又容易引入噪声，所以作者转向特征层。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5897:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:954:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFGM 用多分支膨胀卷积、注意力和中心引导 pair mining 生成多样但靠近共享分布的特征；PLM 用可学习原型给像素级特征加权，挖出跨 VIS/IR 语义相似的局部；Lch 保证原型多样，Ldcs 让类内靠近、类间中心分离。机制和重定义有联系，但比 PDA 弱一些，更像把“潜在局部”问题工程化。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5898:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:986:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 的可见光和红外图像有大模态差异，视觉特征很难直接对齐。已有 CLIP prompt 方法说明语义空间有帮助，但可学习 prompt 语义不透明、太粗、还要两阶段训练。LLaVA 能生成显式细粒度描述，但跨模态描述会有冲突，比如同一衣服在可见光里是蓝色，在红外里像灰色；同一身份不同视角的描述又互补。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5900:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:990:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ESFA 用 LLaVA 给可见光和红外图像生成描述，在各自模态内做图文对齐。CSIA 不直接强拉图像和异模态文本，而是约束“模态内图文相似度”和“跨模态文本相似度”一致，绕开颜色冲突。CVSC 用同身份其他视角文本补偿当前文本，把一对一图文匹配扩成一对多语义对齐。机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5923:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1138:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然 IR 少，直接复制图像会过拟合，SMOTE 又会偏离分布，那么就不在图像空间生成，而是在深层特征里扰动 IR 的 style statistics。SSP 用 IR 特征的均值和方差估计 style 范围，随机采样新的缩放和平移，生成语义不变但风格变化的 IR-like 特征。随后用 MMD 对齐 RGB、真实 IR、扰动 IR 三个分布，再用 CACS 做类中心层面的 intra-class 和 inter-class 约束。机制和重定义绑定很紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5924:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1140:4. **证据闭环**：最关键证据是人为构造不同失衡比例。SYSU-MM01 从 2:1 到 4:1、8:1，很多已有方法 rank-1 和 mAP 大幅下滑，而 CMBL 下滑明显小。组件消融也很有说服力：2:1 下 baseline 是 63.79 rank-1、59.87 mAP，完整 CMBL 到 76.36、71.64；8:1 下 baseline 是 40.20、34.39，完整 CMBL 到 70.62、65.72。SSP 插入层位置、MMD 三项、CACS 的 intra/inter 都分别消融。可视化上还对比 SMOTE 和 SSP 的生成分布，并展示分类 logit 更稳定。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5931:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1162:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5936:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1241:3. 机制怎么长出来：先用少量标注训练分类器，给无标注样本生成带置信度的软身份标签；再用 self-mimic 把同一身份在同一模态内拉向模态特定原型；最后用 mutual distillation 做可见和红外的双向分布对齐。先同模态收紧，再跨模态对齐，机制和重定义绑定很紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5955:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1424:4. 证据闭环：关键不是只报 SOTA，而是分别验证 training sample expansion 和 cross-modal generation 对多个基线都有效，并做生成图、潜空间插值、非线性层消融、统计检验。它在证明“同一个潜空间确实能同时支撑两种生成任务”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5957:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1453:1. 触发观察：VI-ReID 过去常把跨模态差异当作要消除的东西，结果共享对齐会丢掉可见光颜色纹理、红外热特征这些细节；生成式补偿又会引入噪声或依赖辅助模型。BDLF 论文页面也明确把缺口说成“只挖 shared，忽略 modality-specific details”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.03286))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5958:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1457:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是视角和形式化机制。它不是说“我又对齐了一下”，而是说“过度对齐会损失有用细节”。近邻工作里 SGIEL 已经用正交子空间和形状擦除来挖 shared cue，LUPI 也用中间域补信息，所以 BDLF 的边界在“base/detail 相关性分解，而非额外生成或形状特权信息”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.04205?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.09348?utm_source=openai))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5962:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1469:这批论文共同不是从“我加了一个模块”开始，而是先把已有失败讲成一个更精确的新问题：过度对齐丢细节、整体 CLIP 忽略属性、3D 只用几何没用纹理、生成图像缺身份一致性。然后机制基本从这个新定义里长出来，最后用一个能直接验证新定义的消融或可视化闭环兜住，而不是只报涨点。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5964:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1484:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇主要卖机制，视角有但不算特别深。reviewer 会买，是因为它把老的 VI-ReID 模态差异问题换成了一个容易接受的新动作：不要只对齐，要双向交换。真正 novelty 来自“直接用另一模态生成动态投影权重”，不是 GAP/GMP 或 weighted loss。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5980:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1691:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 text 和 sketch 都缺属性，就生成一个同时含轮廓、颜色、纹理的 color sketch 作为桥。CSG 先做动态光照修正，再用 DoG 抽轮廓，并在 YUV 空间把轮廓放到亮度通道、颜色放到色度通道。ACRM 用 dissimilarity 找缺失信息并补偿，再用 photo-query dissimilarity 去掉辅助模态引入的噪声。UCA 再用身份保持、内容一致、三向结构约束和类内紧致损失统一对齐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5987:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1750:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇卖的是完整视角：外部语义不可靠，视频内部可以自生成语义对齐。模块复杂，但每个模块都解释一个具体失败点，所以不像堆模块。novelty 主要来自“self-alignment without human topology”的问题重定义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:5989:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1758:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果 clean 是可靠 exemplar，corrupted 是异质模态，那么 teacher-student 蒸馏很自然：冻结 clean teacher，用 corrupted student 向 clean feature 对齐。严重 corruption 是 hard sample，所以加 weighted contrastive loss。又因为严格对齐会丢信息，所以用 Brownian bridge 生成 clean 与 corrupted 之间的中间特征，填出连续语义结构。机制和重定义绑定很强。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:6026:./reviews/deep_10.md:494:- B 生成/合成数据: CCUP/InfinitePerson/Identity Diffuser/扩散增广,找适中成本+新颖的生成机制(换衣战场PRCC 49 vs SOTA 55-66,CCUP用百万合成预训练)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:6400:./reviews/deep_10.md:10210:3. 机制怎么长出来：模态因子既然跨整个训练集存在，就用类别记忆队列加 memory-attention，再用 OT 让同身份跨模态记忆靠近。姿态因子既然来自人体结构，就用 parsing 和 landmark 生成 skeleton，再用正交分解把 skeleton 里的姿态信息和身份信息拆开。机制和重定义绑定较紧，但模块偏重。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:6404:./reviews/deep_10.md:10242:3. 机制怎么长出来：全局表征负责整个人，属性表征负责细粒度局部属性。ATG 先用属性识别器生成属性文本，TGA 用 CLIP 融合图文得到全局表征，ACN 得到属性级表征；AF 用属性表征对齐旧新模型，KC 用全局表征做知识转移。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:6628:./reviews/deep_1.md:10875:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制基本是自然推出的。既然 2D 帧被遮挡和错位破坏，就用 SMPL/HMR 生成 3D mesh，转成 point cloud，再用 PointPillars 得到和 2D feature 对齐的 pseudo-image feature；CMF 用 deformable cross-attention 和 2D-3D 映射点做融合；SSTI 用 SMPL shape 参数建 spatial/temporal 两条注意力流，专门处理相似外观混淆。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:6629:./reviews/deep_1.md:10883:1. **触发观察**：作者观察到 visible 和 infrared 的频谱分布不同，IR 更集中在低频，visible 有更多中高频细节。现有方法要么做图像生成，要么做特征空间对齐；已有频域 VI-ReID 如 FDNM 已提出频域差异，但大多把频率当成一个统一处理工具。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02162?utm_source=openai))

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:6808:./reviews/deep_11.md:10694:1. 触发观察：VI-ReID 里很多方法都试图补齐或消除可见光和红外的信息差，比如生成、对齐、模态不变特征。作者反过来指出，完全桥接信息差很难，而且即使桥接，也不一定能稳定抓到身份判别线索。真正挑战是模型面对不同模态、不同实例、不同 query 时都要能灵活适配。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:6816:./reviews/deep_11.md:10773:1. 触发观察：VI-ReID 里很多方法都试图补齐或消除可见光和红外的信息差，比如生成、对齐、模态不变特征。作者反过来指出，完全桥接信息差很难，而且即使桥接，也不一定能稳定抓到身份判别线索。真正挑战是模型面对不同模态、不同实例、不同 query 时都要能灵活适配。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:6837:analyses/deep_9.txt:25:1. 触发观察：无监督 text-to-image ReID 不只是没有身份标签，还没有可靠的图文匹配关系。图像聚类能给伪标签，但文本不一定和图像匹配，MLLM 生成文本也会有幻觉和冗余属性。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:6841:analyses/deep_28.txt:40:作者抓住的是 CLIP-ReID 类方法里的一个弱点：两阶段生成的 text prompts 往往不关注行人身份细节。原因是原始 CLIP 对 VI-ReID 不熟，直接生成的提示更偏通用语义，不一定关心跨模态行人身份。另一个观察是，如果同时优化 prompts 和 image encoders，二者目标不同，会互相干扰。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7017:validate/v_3.md:1883:./reviews/deep_25.md:14075:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7085:analyses/deep_25.txt:53:1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7177:reviews/deep_28.md:6893:作者抓住的是 CLIP-ReID 类方法里的一个弱点：两阶段生成的 text prompts 往往不关注行人身份细节。原因是原始 CLIP 对 VI-ReID 不熟，直接生成的提示更偏通用语义，不一定关心跨模态行人身份。另一个观察是，如果同时优化 prompts 和 image encoders，二者目标不同，会互相干扰。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7178:reviews/deep_28.md:6983:作者抓住的是 CLIP-ReID 类方法里的一个弱点：两阶段生成的 text prompts 往往不关注行人身份细节。原因是原始 CLIP 对 VI-ReID 不熟，直接生成的提示更偏通用语义，不一定关心跨模态行人身份。另一个观察是，如果同时优化 prompts 和 image encoders，二者目标不同，会互相干扰。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7183:analyses/deep_22.txt:21:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFGM 用多分支膨胀卷积、注意力和中心引导 pair mining 生成多样但靠近共享分布的特征；PLM 用可学习原型给像素级特征加权，挖出跨 VIS/IR 语义相似的局部；Lch 保证原型多样，Ldcs 让类内靠近、类间中心分离。机制和重定义有联系，但比 PDA 弱一些，更像把“潜在局部”问题工程化。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7256:reviews/deep_9.md:6920:1. 触发观察：无监督 text-to-image ReID 不只是没有身份标签，还没有可靠的图文匹配关系。图像聚类能给伪标签，但文本不一定和图像匹配，MLLM 生成文本也会有幻觉和冗余属性。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7258:reviews/deep_9.md:6967:1. 触发观察：无监督 text-to-image ReID 不只是没有身份标签，还没有可靠的图文匹配关系。图像聚类能给伪标签，但文本不一定和图像匹配，MLLM 生成文本也会有幻觉和冗余属性。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7272:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:954:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFGM 用多分支膨胀卷积、注意力和中心引导 pair mining 生成多样但靠近共享分布的特征；PLM 用可学习原型给像素级特征加权，挖出跨 VIS/IR 语义相似的局部；Lch 保证原型多样，Ldcs 让类内靠近、类间中心分离。机制和重定义有联系，但比 PDA 弱一些，更像把“潜在局部”问题工程化。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7275:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1162:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:10671:reviews/deep_25.md:14083:1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:11574:reviews/deep_22.md:11277:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFGM 用多分支膨胀卷积、注意力和中心引导 pair mining 生成多样但靠近共享分布的特征；PLM 用可学习原型给像素级特征加权，挖出跨 VIS/IR 语义相似的局部；Lch 保证原型多样，Ldcs 让类内靠近、类间中心分离。机制和重定义有联系，但比 PDA 弱一些，更像把“潜在局部”问题工程化。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:12132:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制基本是自然推出的。既然 2D 帧被遮挡和错位破坏，就用 SMPL/HMR 生成 3D mesh，转成 point cloud，再用 PointPillars 得到和 2D feature 对齐的 pseudo-image feature；CMF 用 deformable cross-attention 和 2D-3D 映射点做融合；SSTI 用 SMPL shape 参数建 spatial/temporal 两条注意力流，专门处理相似外观混淆。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:12317:- SD-ReID(diffusion 生成 all-view): 不用 diffusion。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:12650:validate/v_3.md:1877:./reviews/deep_25.md:14051:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然 IR 少，直接复制图像会过拟合，SMOTE 又会偏离分布，那么就不在图像空间生成，而是在深层特征里扰动 IR 的 style statistics。SSP 用 IR 特征的均值和方差估计 style 范围，随机采样新的缩放和平移，生成语义不变但风格变化的 IR-like 特征。随后用 MMD 对齐 RGB、真实 IR、扰动 IR 三个分布，再用 CACS 做类中心层面的 intra-class 和 inter-class 约束。机制和重定义绑定很紧。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:12901:validate/v_3.md:4327:../litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:2174:前 5 篇里已经出现几个高频模式：遮挡论文还在围绕“局部对齐加遮挡权重”，红外论文围绕“跨模态生成或伪标签净化”，泛化论文把“困难样本”重新定义成度量关系被扰动的样本。后面 4 篇我继续按同样口径抽取，最后只保留对我们能发 B 类有用的反推结论。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:12956:validate/v_2.md:324:3. 机制怎么长出来：模态因子既然跨整个训练集存在，就用类别记忆队列加 memory-attention，再用 OT 让同身份跨模态记忆靠近。姿态因子既然来自人体结构，就用 parsing 和 landmark 生成 skeleton，再用正交分解把 skeleton 里的姿态信息和身份信息拆开。机制和重定义绑定较紧，但模块偏重。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:13450:validate/v_2.md:4674:./analyses/deep_3.txt:8:4. 证据闭环：关键不是只报 SOTA，而是分别验证 training sample expansion 和 cross-modal generation 对多个基线都有效，并做生成图、潜空间插值、非线性层消融、统计检验。它在证明“同一个潜空间确实能同时支撑两种生成任务”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:13452:validate/v_2.md:4713:./analyses/deep_10.txt:7:3. 机制怎么长出来：模态因子既然跨整个训练集存在，就用类别记忆队列加 memory-attention，再用 OT 让同身份跨模态记忆靠近。姿态因子既然来自人体结构，就用 parsing 和 landmark 生成 skeleton，再用正交分解把 skeleton 里的姿态信息和身份信息拆开。机制和重定义绑定较紧，但模块偏重。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:13459:validate/v_2.md:4768:./reviews/deep_25.md:356:- B 生成/合成数据: CCUP/InfinitePerson/Identity Diffuser/扩散增广,找适中成本+新颖的生成机制(换衣战场PRCC 49 vs SOTA 55-66,CCUP用百万合成预训练)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:13490:validate/v_2.md:5100:./reviews/deep_25.md:14051:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然 IR 少，直接复制图像会过拟合，SMOTE 又会偏离分布，那么就不在图像空间生成，而是在深层特征里扰动 IR 的 style statistics。SSP 用 IR 特征的均值和方差估计 style 范围，随机采样新的缩放和平移，生成语义不变但风格变化的 IR-like 特征。随后用 MMD 对齐 RGB、真实 IR、扰动 IR 三个分布，再用 CACS 做类中心层面的 intra-class 和 inter-class 约束。机制和重定义绑定很紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:13491:validate/v_2.md:5101:./reviews/deep_25.md:14053:4. **证据闭环**：最关键证据是人为构造不同失衡比例。SYSU-MM01 从 2:1 到 4:1、8:1，很多已有方法 rank-1 和 mAP 大幅下滑，而 CMBL 下滑明显小。组件消融也很有说服力：2:1 下 baseline 是 63.79 rank-1、59.87 mAP，完整 CMBL 到 76.36、71.64；8:1 下 baseline 是 40.20、34.39，完整 CMBL 到 70.62、65.72。SSP 插入层位置、MMD 三项、CACS 的 intra/inter 都分别消融。可视化上还对比 SMOTE 和 SSP 的生成分布，并展示分类 logit 更稳定。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:13495:validate/v_2.md:5112:./reviews/deep_25.md:14130:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然 IR 少，直接复制图像会过拟合，SMOTE 又会偏离分布，那么就不在图像空间生成，而是在深层特征里扰动 IR 的 style statistics。SSP 用 IR 特征的均值和方差估计 style 范围，随机采样新的缩放和平移，生成语义不变但风格变化的 IR-like 特征。随后用 MMD 对齐 RGB、真实 IR、扰动 IR 三个分布，再用 CACS 做类中心层面的 intra-class 和 inter-class 约束。机制和重定义绑定很紧。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:14012:validate/v_2.md:11574:reviews/deep_22.md:11277:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFGM 用多分支膨胀卷积、注意力和中心引导 pair mining 生成多样但靠近共享分布的特征；PLM 用可学习原型给像素级特征加权，挖出跨 VIS/IR 语义相似的局部；Lch 保证原型多样，Ldcs 让类内靠近、类间中心分离。机制和重定义有联系，但比 PDA 弱一些，更像把“潜在局部”问题工程化。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:14351: 11273	1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 里常见做法是水平切分身体做局部对齐，但行人姿态、视角和运动不规则，水平条带经常语义错位。生成式跨模态图像又容易引入噪声，所以作者转向特征层。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:14355: 11277	3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFGM 用多分支膨胀卷积、注意力和中心引导 pair mining 生成多样但靠近共享分布的特征；PLM 用可学习原型给像素级特征加权，挖出跨 VIS/IR 语义相似的局部；Lch 保证原型多样，Ldcs 让类内靠近、类间中心分离。机制和重定义有联系，但比 PDA 弱一些，更像把“潜在局部”问题工程化。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:14359: 11281	5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇主要卖机制，不是强视角。novelty 来自把“水平部位不可靠”替换成“可学习原型挖潜在语义局部”，再用多特征生成解决模态分布不够的问题。它可学的一点是：先否定一个常用结构先验，再给出一个数据驱动替代物。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:14387: 11309	1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 的可见光和红外图像有大模态差异，视觉特征很难直接对齐。已有 CLIP prompt 方法说明语义空间有帮助，但可学习 prompt 语义不透明、太粗、还要两阶段训练。LLaVA 能生成显式细粒度描述，但跨模态描述会有冲突，比如同一衣服在可见光里是蓝色，在红外里像灰色；同一身份不同视角的描述又互补。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:14391: 11313	3. **机制怎么长出来**：ESFA 用 LLaVA 给可见光和红外图像生成描述，在各自模态内做图文对齐。CSIA 不直接强拉图像和异模态文本，而是约束“模态内图文相似度”和“跨模态文本相似度”一致，绕开颜色冲突。CVSC 用同身份其他视角文本补偿当前文本，把一对一图文匹配扩成一对多语义对齐。机制和重定义绑定非常紧。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2648:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:494:**候选二先例核查(codex 3/10, candidate2_vs_c2r-codex.md, 决策#52)**: 免重建索引+持续兼容转移被 C2R(CVPR24)/Bi-C2R(TPAMI26)/URCPD(AAAI26) 占; 新旧兼容+在线部分回填+预算曲线被 BCT 系/Hot-refresh(ICLR22,已做回填比例+预算曲线)/DGR 占。窄空白=多版本原始特征同库+相机/时间非均匀陈旧+预算调度,且增益须可证来自版本年龄结构。前提门=两条独立序列在 Market 上看混版本是否明显掉点+随版本年龄单调(对照各版本 native 自评排"质量阶梯"混淆)。不过→转候选三(阶段顺序敏感桥选择,未撞免重建/BCT 工业线); 过→仍须全套破坏性归因(打乱版本/随机陈旧/全重提/年龄反转吃掉70%增益)+超 C2R 全量转移基线+三种子才算贡献(同杀模块线那道归因门)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2649:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:496:**两条独立先导(都在跑)**: lab-4090=Market→MSMT→OccDuke(主, ~13s/epoch); hyy GPU0=Market→OccPoseTrack→OccDuke(独立复现,不同中间域,防单序列偶然)。两条都在 Market 上做陈旧索引评测(eval_lifelong_stale.py 已用 Occ-Duke ViT-base 53.70 复现校验通过)。完成等待器 b2adeq7sh(lab-4090)/b8pv682at(hyy)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:2667:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:670:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:3401:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_16.md:305:**候选二先例核查(codex 3/10, candidate2_vs_c2r-codex.md, 决策#52)**: 免重建索引+持续兼容转移被 C2R(CVPR24)/Bi-C2R(TPAMI26)/URCPD(AAAI26) 占; 新旧兼容+在线部分回填+预算曲线被 BCT 系/Hot-refresh(ICLR22,已做回填比例+预算曲线)/DGR 占。窄空白=多版本原始特征同库+相机/时间非均匀陈旧+预算调度,且增益须可证来自版本年龄结构。前提门=两条独立序列在 Market 上看混版本是否明显掉点+随版本年龄单调(对照各版本 native 自评排"质量阶梯"混淆)。不过→转候选三(阶段顺序敏感桥选择,未撞免重建/BCT 工业线); 过→仍须全套破坏性归因(打乱版本/随机陈旧/全重提/年龄反转吃掉70%增益)+超 C2R 全量转移基线+三种子才算贡献(同杀模块线那道归因门)。

# exp366 Active Evidence Acquisition — monitor

## cheap kill-switch（frozen SOLIDER, 零训练, 2026-06-28）

验 codex 范式 #1：query 主动获取第二证据（同 ID 不同 camera），policy（margin 选 hard query 花预算）能否接近 oracle 且 >> random。

| 数据集 | baseline | oracle-all (2nd) | policy (hard 20%) | random (20%) | frac | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Market（exp260b 强）| 94.43 | +2.51 | **+0.31** | +0.48 | 0.12 | DEAD（policy<random）|
| Occluded-Duke（exp004_pfm⚠️）| 3.09⚠️ | +6.45 | **+1.29** | +1.31 | 0.20 | DEAD（policy≈random）|

⚠️ Occluded baseline 3.09 异常低（exp004_pfm ckpt 配 market config 的 FrozenExtractor 加载不匹配）；但 policy vs random 是相对比较、不依赖 baseline 绝对值，结论成立。

## ★VERDICT DEAD（两数据集坐实）

margin（top1-top2 检索不确定性）**不是好的"值得获取证据"预算信号**：Market policy+0.31<random+0.48；Occluded policy+1.29≈random+1.31。两数据集 policy 都 ≈/< random。

**★范式根本困难（诚实诊断）**：
1. 系统不知道哪个 query 的第二证据有用（要获取才知道=鸡生蛋）。
2. margin 小（难 query）给证据没用——第二证据也可能难（occluded query 另一张也 occluded）。
3. 任何"检索不确定性"policy（margin/entropy 同质）都救不了，因为不确定 ≠ 第二证据能救。

oracle headroom 真实（occluded +6.45 R1 大涨），但**没有 cheap policy 信号能逼近它**。主动获取证据要价值，需要预测"第二证据质量"，而那本身要先获取（鸡生蛋）。

## 决定

Active Evidence policy DEAD（cheap kill-switch 半小时验透，没浪费训练）。转 **Generative Index ReID（codex 范式 #2，6.5/10 真空白）**：gallery identity 离散 token，query 生成 code prefix，kill-switch=PQ code recall<95% 则杀。

# exp362 gap-measured occlusion engine — gap 审计（negative control）

## 由来
PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain（exp361）判死后，codex pivot 决策选生成数据引擎（6/10，窄缝=gap-measured occlusion distribution engine，必须赢 PLBOA）。第一步 cheap kill-switch：先 gap 审计验证前提（train-test 遮挡分布 gap 是否存在）。

## gap 审计（2026-06-27，cheap，no training，no diffusion）

**pose visibility threshold sweep（occluded_duke train N=15618 vs query N=2210）**：

| VIS_THR | legs gap | arm gap | heavy-occ(可见组≤2) gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.3 | +9.2% (q9.5/t0.4) | rarm +0.5 | +0.1% |
| 0.5 | +16.4% (q17.2/t0.8) | larm +2.0 / rarm +2.1 | +1.0% |
| 0.7 | +26.1% (q28.1/t2.0) | larm +8.9 / rarm +5.9 | +5.1% |

**gap 形态确认：各 threshold 下始终主导 lower-body（legs），arm 次之（高 thr 才显现），heavy-occ 始终少。**

## ★结论：生成引擎窄缝被 PLBOA 占 → 转 LM-ReID（codex 2.5-3/10）

- gap 几乎全在 legs（lower-body），**正是 PLBOA（Pose-guided Lower-Body Occlusion，3-seed +1.37 mAP）已经在补的**。
- 生成引擎要成立 = 在 PLBOA 已覆盖的 lower-body gap 上**净增益**（否则只是"更贵的 PLBOA"）。窄缝太窄。
- caveat：pose visibility ≠ 真遮挡（codex），但 occluded_duke **无官方 mask**（真 mask audit 要跑 human parsing，中等成本）；且最强相对信号始终是 legs（非全身 heavy occlusion），caveat 不足以救生成线。
- **codex 综合判：转 LM-ReID**（exp359，诚实 6.5 B 类候选，表链全：强 TTA 对照/聚合消融/因子消融/K-sweep/backbone 泛化/σ-sweep/训练端反例）。exp362 保留为 audit/negative control。

## ★★换量级在 occluded ReID 内部的诚实困境（重大节点）

范式转向（换量级）在 occluded ReID 内部探索了多个 build，**都接近墙**：
- Intruder（exp360）DEAD：donor 可读但压它不救排序。
- PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain（exp361）DEAD：partial-view JEPA 与 ReID 判别性本质冲突（41/50 << 58.5）。
- 生成引擎（exp362）2.5-3/10：gap 被 PLBOA 占。
- support-bank aux 4/10 死：撞 SCKD 穷尽（+0.1）/FGEU 16.3%。

cheap kill-switch（Stage0.5 frozen 因果 / gap 审计纯 numpy）省了多次大投入——这是分工（先验证再大 build）的价值。**用户拍板节点**：接受"occluded ReID 内部换量级接近墙"+ 回 LM-ReID 6.5 收尾投 B 类（最务实）/ 生成引擎 human parsing 最后一搏 / 转非遮挡 reframe。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:6945:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r2.md:4540:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3549:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12945:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10467:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8030:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",

Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",

experiments/exp367_single_support/monitor.md:39:★诚实诊断：① **train loss 几乎 0（0.004）= episode 太易**（N=16 id 分类，support-query 同 id 分类到 16 id 太易）→ **CVaR worst tail≈0，CVaR term 没起作用**；② head 学 episode 分类过拟合 → eval 掉（frozen+projection 只能旋转特征，codex 预言）。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_smoke.md:14:审查 experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_ss_cvar_smoke.py(Single-Support CVaR frozen-head smoke 训练, codex 设计的 two-level CVaR)。逐行查 bug + 训练逻辑。审: (a)episodic single-support CVaR loss 对吗——episode N id×K 图, 每 support-slot 当 prototype 其余 query 分类到 N proto 的 CE, per-id K 个 support risk 做 CVaR_α worst tail, L=mean_CE+lam·CVaR? (b)和 codex 设计(two-level: support risk→CVaR per id)一致吗? (c)random mode(无 CVaR)对照对吗? (d)评估 projected query/gallery→full/random/worst-support 对吗(复用 probe v2 口径)? (e)会退化普通 hard-mining 吗? frozen head(init eye)+backbone 冻对吗? loss 数值稳定(topk/CE shape)? verdict approve/needs-attention + 简短理由。务实中文。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:12578:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:6945:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r2.md:4540:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3549:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12945:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4629:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8884:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3699:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4629:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8884:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7139:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2331:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:1753:../../cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:160:**"observation-limited evidence ceiling 下 clean(f_full)/recover(f_rec)evidence head 分化 + 固定先验软融合(fixed-prior fusion)"**——**不是** query-budget routing / resolution-adaptive dual-branch(那会撞 RAR arxiv 2207.13037 = resolution-adaptive metric、MRJL 2105.12684 = multi-resolution dual-branch fusion、cross-resolution ReID)。实现就是单一**固定** w=0.25 软融合(`cos = w·cos_rec + (1−w)·cos_full`), **不是动态 router**: kill-switch #3 已证硬 per-query 路由(area / reliability)回收不了 trade-off(≤+0.41), 增益全来自固定 w 软混合。所以诚实地主张 **observation-limited evidence ceiling → 两个 evidence head(full-evidence vs recoverable)分化 → fixed-prior 软融合**, 不吹 "按 query 路由证据空间"。codex assess2 已查 asymmetric ReID / DECAMEL / QPM 先例 → 贡献钉在 AG-ReID 的 recoverable-evidence ceiling + fair-evidence matching, 非 view-specific projection 本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r2.md:1620:./experiments/exp356r_pcmsc_random/claude_review.md:46:`__init__` PC-MSC 块 (line 263-275): `_rng=get_rng_state()`(265) 包住 `CLIPVisualEncoder(...)`(open_clip create_model 消耗 RNG) + `pcmsc_query=randn`(消耗) + `pcmsc_decoder=MHA`(消耗) + `pcmsc_proj=Linear`(消耗)，`set_rng_state(_rng)`(275) 在**全部 4 个消耗 RNG 的创建之后**复位。→ line 275 之后 RNG 状态 == line 265 之前 == exp341 同点。`bottleneck`/`classifier`/backbone 在 `super().__init__()`(line 37) 即创建，远早于本块，本就不受影响。复位位置正确（同 line 71/77、231/234 已复现的姊妹模式）。CPU-only `get/set_rng_state` 与姊妹模块一致（init 在 CPU）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r2.md:3871:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1084:experiments/exp356r_pcmsc_random/claude_review.md:46:`__init__` PC-MSC 块 (line 263-275): `_rng=get_rng_state()`(265) 包住 `CLIPVisualEncoder(...)`(open_clip create_model 消耗 RNG) + `pcmsc_query=randn`(消耗) + `pcmsc_decoder=MHA`(消耗) + `pcmsc_proj=Linear`(消耗)，`set_rng_state(_rng)`(275) 在**全部 4 个消耗 RNG 的创建之后**复位。→ line 275 之后 RNG 状态 == line 265 之前 == exp341 同点。`bottleneck`/`classifier`/backbone 在 `super().__init__()`(line 37) 即创建，远早于本块，本就不受影响。复位位置正确（同 line 71/77、231/234 已复现的姊妹模式）。CPU-only `get/set_rng_state` 与姊妹模块一致（init 在 CPU）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r2.md:4540:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3549:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12945:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r2.md:4632:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8030:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage4.md:20466:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:1648:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:39:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:1753:../../cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:160:**"observation-limited evidence ceiling 下 clean(f_full)/recover(f_rec)evidence head 分化 + 固定先验软融合(fixed-prior fusion)"**——**不是** query-budget routing / resolution-adaptive dual-branch(那会撞 RAR arxiv 2207.13037 = resolution-adaptive metric、MRJL 2105.12684 = multi-resolution dual-branch fusion、cross-resolution ReID)。实现就是单一**固定** w=0.25 软融合(`cos = w·cos_rec + (1−w)·cos_full`), **不是动态 router**: kill-switch #3 已证硬 per-query 路由(area / reliability)回收不了 trade-off(≤+0.41), 增益全来自固定 w 软混合。所以诚实地主张 **observation-limited evidence ceiling → 两个 evidence head(full-evidence vs recoverable)分化 → fixed-prior 软融合**, 不吹 "按 query 路由证据空间"。codex assess2 已查 asymmetric ReID / DECAMEL / QPM 先例 → 贡献钉在 AG-ReID 的 recoverable-evidence ceiling + fair-evidence matching, 非 view-specific projection 本身。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_r1.md:549:./experiments/exp357_pose_shuffle_ks/design.md:4:8-路 codex 讨论结论: "语义无关"洞察单独发不了 B 类, 唯一翻盘路 = #1 query-invariance 机制。但**整个故事赌一个前提: "pose 的空间内容是因果的"**。codex red-team(file00/07)最强警告: **若 pose-shuffle 训练不掉点, "pose spatial prior 是价值"的故事当场塌**——那 LGPA 增益其实只是"有个部位结构 + 部位监督", 与 pose 正确定位无关。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4436:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4968:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5008:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_openset_check.md:11695:一个 ReID 团队要做一个统一视角的 CCF-B 方法/分析稿: **'gallery 组成(规模 size / 随时间膨胀 growth / distractor 分布 / prototype support count)是 ReID 真实失败的被忽略驱动, 不只看 query/模型'**。三个 instantiation(3 个独立 codex 收敛): ①gallery-growth-tax(LReID 旧域掉点部分是 gallery 膨胀的误归因而非 catastrophic forgetting, frozen 模型也掉); ②gallery-size-conditioned 拒识(open-set 阈值该随 watchlist size 变, 大 gallery impostor max-score 上升); ③singleton-tail-merge(尾部身份被错并入 head prototype)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:160:**"observation-limited evidence ceiling 下 clean(f_full)/recover(f_rec)evidence head 分化 + 固定先验软融合(fixed-prior fusion)"**——**不是** query-budget routing / resolution-adaptive dual-branch(那会撞 RAR arxiv 2207.13037 = resolution-adaptive metric、MRJL 2105.12684 = multi-resolution dual-branch fusion、cross-resolution ReID)。实现就是单一**固定** w=0.25 软融合(`cos = w·cos_rec + (1−w)·cos_full`), **不是动态 router**: kill-switch #3 已证硬 per-query 路由(area / reliability)回收不了 trade-off(≤+0.41), 增益全来自固定 w 软混合。所以诚实地主张 **observation-limited evidence ceiling → 两个 evidence head(full-evidence vs recoverable)分化 → fixed-prior 软融合**, 不吹 "按 query 路由证据空间"。codex assess2 已查 asymmetric ReID / DECAMEL / QPM 先例 → 贡献钉在 AG-ReID 的 recoverable-evidence ceiling + fair-evidence matching, 非 view-specific projection 本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:4768:../new_angle_AIRL.md:160:**"observation-limited evidence ceiling 下 clean(f_full)/recover(f_rec)evidence head 分化 + 固定先验软融合(fixed-prior fusion)"**——**不是** query-budget routing / resolution-adaptive dual-branch(那会撞 RAR arxiv 2207.13037 = resolution-adaptive metric、MRJL 2105.12684 = multi-resolution dual-branch fusion、cross-resolution ReID)。实现就是单一**固定** w=0.25 软融合(`cos = w·cos_rec + (1−w)·cos_full`), **不是动态 router**: kill-switch #3 已证硬 per-query 路由(area / reliability)回收不了 trade-off(≤+0.41), 增益全来自固定 w 软混合。所以诚实地主张 **observation-limited evidence ceiling → 两个 evidence head(full-evidence vs recoverable)分化 → fixed-prior 软融合**, 不吹 "按 query 路由证据空间"。codex assess2 已查 asymmetric ReID / DECAMEL / QPM 先例 → 贡献钉在 AG-ReID 的 recoverable-evidence ceiling + fair-evidence matching, 非 view-specific projection 本身。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:2297:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12146:../codex_review_raw.txt:4436:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",

(3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1917:reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_new_paradigm.md:14:用户明确指令: 放下 LM-ReID, 找**新的 person ReID 范式级别创新**(不是小修小补/模块/变体, 是问题重定义 or 全新机制 or 新监督范式)。**这些已探透全证伪/偏弱/撞先例, 严禁推回**: occluded 内部(Intruder/PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain/生成引擎/support set)/AG 视频证据积累/DG foundation-preserving/gallery(hubness/rank-regret/OSAC)/open-set 阈值-watchlist/Wildlife species-conditioning/VI-ReID(SMPL-anchor)/LM-ReID lattice marginalization 训练端六点定律/SMPL 几何(对 ReID 无独特信号)/FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD frozen 弱)/test-time trick。**深度调研真没探+范式级(2024-2026 最新, web search)**: (a)**问题重定义**: 主动 ReID(active query)/因果 ReID(去 camera-confounder, do-calculus)/联邦隐私 ReID/终身 continual ReID/生成式检索(generative retrieval, ID 当 token)/可解释 ReID/逆问题 ReID——逐个判 novelty+2024-26 先例+4 单卡可行+cheap kill-switch。(b)**新监督范式**: 自监督已 SOLIDER/LUPerson 占, 还有啥? 合成数据 scaling(3D 引擎/diffusion 造 ID)/弱监督/跨模态(audio-gait-language)/test-time training。(c)**新机制范式**: diffusion-ReID/in-context ReID(检索增强 ICL)/equivariant ReID/神经渲染 3D-person canonical。**要求**: 给 3-5 个真没探+范式级+有 2024-26 novelty 空白+4 单卡可行+有 cheap kill-switch 的, 排序+每个第一步零训练 kill-switch。务实中文, 诚实判别硬凑, **不要推回上面已死方向**。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_new_paradigm.md:3522:- query 只预测最近 code prefix，取 top-B buckets 后再 cosine rerank。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_new_paradigm.md:3556:2. `Generative Index ReID` gallery-code recall kill-switch。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_next.md:2869:★诚实诊断：① **train loss 几乎 0（0.004）= episode 太易**（N=16 id 分类，support-query 同 id 分类到 16 id 太易）→ **CVaR worst tail≈0，CVaR term 没起作用**；② head 学 episode 分类过拟合 → eval 掉（frozen+projection 只能旋转特征，codex 预言）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_next.md:3002:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_next.md:3295:Active Evidence policy DEAD（cheap kill-switch 半小时验透，没浪费训练）。转 **Generative Index ReID（codex 范式 #2，6.5/10 真空白）**：gallery identity 离散 token，query 生成 code prefix，kill-switch=PQ code recall<95% 则杀。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_next.md:3418:- DEAD → 主动获取证据无 policy 价值（等 trivial multi-query），转 Generative Index（codex #2，6.5/10 真空白）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_next.md:3461:| 1 | **Generative Identity-Code ReID** | 不再学一个 cosine descriptor，而是训练 query 生成目标 gallery 的 PQ/code-prefix，再用 code 候选精排。 | 不是 hubness/rank-regret scorer；不是 FM；不是 test-time marginalization；训练的是“检索索引算子”。但若你把所有 gallery/index 方向都禁掉，此项直接删。 | 冻结现有强特征，给 gallery 聚 PQ/hier code；训小 decoder 预测正样本 code。成功线：top-N code recall 明显高于 nearest-code/random-code，候选精排 mAP 正增；按 baseline `#false@10` 分桶报告 ΔAP，且固定候选数。 | **6.8** | general 侧已有 [DSI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.06991)、[NCI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.02743)；ReID 有老 hashing/[PDH](https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.02145)。风险是“生成式检索搬到 ReID”而非全新。 |

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4892:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2272:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:6121:把 gallery identity 表成离散 code 序列或 product-quantized evidence tokens。Query 不输出一个 embedding，而输出 `p(code_1...code_m | x)`；检索是生成式候选召回 + 原特征 rerank。

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_avoid_oracle_wall.md:4832:★诚实诊断：① **train loss 几乎 0（0.004）= episode 太易**（N=16 id 分类，support-query 同 id 分类到 16 id 太易）→ **CVaR worst tail≈0，CVaR term 没起作用**；② head 学 episode 分类过拟合 → eval 掉（frozen+projection 只能旋转特征，codex 预言）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:6203:一个 ReID 团队要做一个统一视角的 CCF-B 方法/分析稿: **'gallery 组成(规模 size / 随时间膨胀 growth / distractor 分布 / prototype support count)是 ReID 真实失败的被忽略驱动, 不只看 query/模型'**。三个 instantiation(3 个独立 codex 收敛): ①gallery-growth-tax(LReID 旧域掉点部分是 gallery 膨胀的误归因而非 catastrophic forgetting, frozen 模型也掉); ②gallery-size-conditioned 拒识(open-set 阈值该随 watchlist size 变, 大 gallery impostor max-score 上升); ③singleton-tail-merge(尾部身份被错并入 head prototype)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_paradigm_GEN.md:14:调研: 用生成式范式(autoregressive/diffusion/generative-retrieval)重新定义 person ReID(而非判别 embedding), 有人做吗? 能降维打击吗? (1)generative retrieval(query 直接生成 gallery ID code, 像 DSI/NCI)在 ReID 先例? (2)diffusion-ReID 是生成增强还是生成式检索? (3)autoregressive person-ID/token generation? (4)诚实关键判断: 生成式判别性通常弱(判别式 ReID 已 Market 95%+), 生成式范式能赢在判别式哪个根本短板(开放集/可解释/可组合查询?)还是注定打不过? 我们验过 generative-index(efficiency 范式)kill-switch trivial。有空白吗+novel 角度+cheap kill-switch+CCF-B 分。web search 最新。务实中文别捧场。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:2439:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28409:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:39:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:5792:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28409:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:39:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
