experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3549:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12945:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8030:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:9490:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4436:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_dg_deepen.md:4259:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:2700:experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_5.md:9909:../new_angle_AIRL.md:160:**"observation-limited evidence ceiling 下 clean(f_full)/recover(f_rec)evidence head 分化 + 固定先验软融合(fixed-prior fusion)"**——**不是** query-budget routing / resolution-adaptive dual-branch(那会撞 RAR arxiv 2207.13037 = resolution-adaptive metric、MRJL 2105.12684 = multi-resolution dual-branch fusion、cross-resolution ReID)。实现就是单一**固定** w=0.25 软融合(`cos = w·cos_rec + (1−w)·cos_full`), **不是动态 router**: kill-switch #3 已证硬 per-query 路由(area / reliability)回收不了 trade-off(≤+0.41), 增益全来自固定 w 软混合。所以诚实地主张 **observation-limited evidence ceiling → 两个 evidence head(full-evidence vs recoverable)分化 → fixed-prior 软融合**, 不吹 "按 query 路由证据空间"。codex assess2 已查 asymmetric ReID / DECAMEL / QPM 先例 → 贡献钉在 AG-ReID 的 recoverable-evidence ceiling + fair-evidence matching, 非 view-specific projection 本身。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_dg_deepen.md:5847:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:971:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:39:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_ag_verify.md:1998:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2588:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:6356:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:18378:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14254:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2331:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:1753:../../cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:160:**"observation-limited evidence ceiling 下 clean(f_full)/recover(f_rec)evidence head 分化 + 固定先验软融合(fixed-prior fusion)"**——**不是** query-budget routing / resolution-adaptive dual-branch(那会撞 RAR arxiv 2207.13037 = resolution-adaptive metric、MRJL 2105.12684 = multi-resolution dual-branch fusion、cross-resolution ReID)。实现就是单一**固定** w=0.25 软融合(`cos = w·cos_rec + (1−w)·cos_full`), **不是动态 router**: kill-switch #3 已证硬 per-query 路由(area / reliability)回收不了 trade-off(≤+0.41), 增益全来自固定 w 软混合。所以诚实地主张 **observation-limited evidence ceiling → 两个 evidence head(full-evidence vs recoverable)分化 → fixed-prior 软融合**, 不吹 "按 query 路由证据空间"。codex assess2 已查 asymmetric ReID / DECAMEL / QPM 先例 → 贡献钉在 AG-ReID 的 recoverable-evidence ceiling + fair-evidence matching, 非 view-specific projection 本身。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:22085:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2588:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28409:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:39:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30065:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31000:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3699:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4629:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8884:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

**结论**
截至 2026-06-28 的 web search：我没找到 **person ReID 里 DSI/NCI 式 query image 直接生成 gallery ID/code** 的明确先例。这个形式上有空白，但我不认为能“降维打击”标准 ReID。它更像把 ReID 退化成闭库分类器 / hash bucket 预测，判别性、开放集、动态 gallery 都吃亏。

**逐项判断**

1. **Generative retrieval 先例**
   - 文本 IR 里很明确：DSI 把语料记进 Transformer 参数，query 直接生成 docid；NCI 是 seq2seq 直接生成相关 document identifiers。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.06991)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.02743))
   - 多模态检索里也已有类似 generative CMR：给每个 target 分配唯一 identifier，再由生成模型直接预测 identifier。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.13172))
   - ReID 里我没查到同构先例。大规模 ReID 的效率路线主要是 deep hashing / ANN，而不是 autoregressive ID generation。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.02145))

2. **Diffusion-ReID 是什么**
   - 主要是 **生成增强 / 预训练数据扩展**，不是生成式检索。Diffusion-ReID 生成 Diff-Person 数据集，再预训练 ReID backbone。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.06045))
   - DLCR 也是 diffusion inpainting 改衣服、扩 CC-ReID 数据，2.1M 合成图，服务判别式模型训练。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.07205))
   - Pose2ID 更接近“生成多姿态同 ID 图像后做 feature centralization”，仍然是生成辅助 embedding/re-ranking，不是 query 生成 gallery ID。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.00938))

3. **Autoregressive person-ID/token generation**
   - 没找到“图像 query → 自回归生成 person ID / gallery code”的 ReID 论文。
   - 现有 token generation 多是 semantic query / learnable token / CLIP prompt token，例如 ViSA 的 view-aware semantic queries、CG-CLIP 的 caption/text memory 与 token aggregation；不是生成检索目标 ID。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18192)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07740))

4. **为什么标准 ReID 上大概率打不过**
   - 标准 Market 类 ReID 已高度饱和，判别式 embedding 早就有 95%+ R1，甚至有报告 Market R1 98.27%。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.03720))
   - DSI 本身也有硬伤：后续分析指出它擅长记 pseudo query→docid，但区分 relevant documents vs random documents 能力不足。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.02073))
   - ReID 的 test identity/gallery 是动态的；若生成器记 gallery，就是 transductive index；若预测 PQ/hash code，就是 ANN/hash 的复杂替代。你们已经验过 generative-index efficiency kill-switch trivial，这条不建议再投。

**还有没有空白**
有，但不是“直接生成 ID”。更像下面这些窄角：

| 方向 | 空白/新意 | cheap kill-switch | CCF-B 分 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct DSI-ReID | ReID 里形式空白 | 生成 top-K bucket 后 true-gallery 覆盖率 vs FAISS/PQ；若为 99% recall 要扫 >5% gallery，死 | 2.5/10 |
| Diffusion-ReID 增强 | 已拥挤，Diffusion-ReID/DLCR/Pose2ID 都占了 | gap audit：生成变化是否覆盖 PLBOA 没覆盖的真实 gap；若仍是 lower-body occlusion，死 | 2-3/10 |
| AR person-ID token | 先例少，但本质闭库分类/索引 | unseen-gallery split：换 gallery IDs 后 code recall 是否崩；崩则无开放集价值 | 3/10 |
| Generative evidence verifier | 不生成 ID，而生成“可解释证据/矛盾”：部位、遮挡、衣服残差、非目标人干扰 | 用 MLLM/attribute parser 对 top10 false vs true 做 token-disagreement AUC；重排 +0.5 mAP 才继续 | 5.5-6.5/10 |
| Open-world/compositional ReID | 胜点在拒识、可组合查询、多证据，而非 Market mAP | watchlist + distractor：生成式证据能否降低 false accept，同时不伤 true accept | 5-6/10 |

**务实建议**
不要把“生成式范式”作为标准 ReID embedding 替代路线。能讲 B 类的唯一可能是改问题定义：**开放集/组合查询/可解释证据/反事实矛盾检测**。最便宜下一步不是训练生成器，而是先做一个 frozen probe：对 top-K false positives 生成结构化证据，看它是否真能把“相似衣服假阳性”和“同 ID 遮挡变化”分开。分不开，这条也直接杀。

   - Pose2ID 更接近“生成多姿态同 ID 图像后做 feature centralization”，仍然是生成辅助 embedding/re-ranking，不是 query 生成 gallery ID。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.00938))

3. **Autoregressive person-ID/token generation**
   - 没找到“图像 query → 自回归生成 person ID / gallery code”的 ReID 论文。
   - 现有 token generation 多是 semantic query / learnable token / CLIP prompt token，例如 ViSA 的 view-aware semantic queries、CG-CLIP 的 caption/text memory 与 token aggregation；不是生成检索目标 ID。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18192)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07740))

4. **为什么标准 ReID 上大概率打不过**
   - 标准 Market 类 ReID 已高度饱和，判别式 embedding 早就有 95%+ R1，甚至有报告 Market R1 98.27%。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.03720))
   - DSI 本身也有硬伤：后续分析指出它擅长记 pseudo query→docid，但区分 relevant documents vs random documents 能力不足。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.02073))
   - ReID 的 test identity/gallery 是动态的；若生成器记 gallery，就是 transductive index；若预测 PQ/hash code，就是 ANN/hash 的复杂替代。你们已经验过 generative-index efficiency kill-switch trivial，这条不建议再投。

**还有没有空白**
有，但不是“直接生成 ID”。更像下面这些窄角：

| 方向 | 空白/新意 | cheap kill-switch | CCF-B 分 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct DSI-ReID | ReID 里形式空白 | 生成 top-K bucket 后 true-gallery 覆盖率 vs FAISS/PQ；若为 99% recall 要扫 >5% gallery，死 | 2.5/10 |
| Diffusion-ReID 增强 | 已拥挤，Diffusion-ReID/DLCR/Pose2ID 都占了 | gap audit：生成变化是否覆盖 PLBOA 没覆盖的真实 gap；若仍是 lower-body occlusion，死 | 2-3/10 |
| AR person-ID token | 先例少，但本质闭库分类/索引 | unseen-gallery split：换 gallery IDs 后 code recall 是否崩；崩则无开放集价值 | 3/10 |
| Generative evidence verifier | 不生成 ID，而生成“可解释证据/矛盾”：部位、遮挡、衣服残差、非目标人干扰 | 用 MLLM/attribute parser 对 top10 false vs true 做 token-disagreement AUC；重排 +0.5 mAP 才继续 | 5.5-6.5/10 |
| Open-world/compositional ReID | 胜点在拒识、可组合查询、多证据，而非 Market mAP | watchlist + distractor：生成式证据能否降低 false accept，同时不伤 true accept | 5-6/10 |

**务实建议**
不要把“生成式范式”作为标准 ReID embedding 替代路线。能讲 B 类的唯一可能是改问题定义：**开放集/组合查询/可解释证据/反事实矛盾检测**。最便宜下一步不是训练生成器，而是先做一个 frozen probe：对 top-K false positives 生成结构化证据，看它是否真能把“相似衣服假阳性”和“同 ID 遮挡变化”分开。分不开，这条也直接杀。
